title: Restore projection after Desktop restart

source_requirement.behavior_to_preserve: canonical Workstream and stored presentation references
parent_acceptance: Canvas/TUI switching, hide/show, Desktop restart, daemon reconnect, and contribution recomposition retain the required invariants.

destination.host: Focusa Desktop Mission Canvas Svelte GUI tab
destination.agent_tui_boundary: Agent TUI remains the separate authentic PTY-backed Pi terminal; it is never the Mission Canvas renderer.

typed_input: canonical Workstream and stored presentation references

ordered_steps.instruction: Verify every dependency is complete with evidence: ['LIVE-001', 'LIVE-003', 'PROFILE-002', 'PTY-010']. Stop on blocked, partial, or missing evidence.

Read these sources completely before editing: ['docs/135g-multiplexed-mission-canvas-work-surfaces-session-attachments-and-browser-context-isolation-spec.md']. Follow CARDINAL-135-SVELTE-001; Pi-overlay files are behavior sources, not the destination host.

Inspect only these destination paths and named symbols before changing code: ['apps/desktop/src/lib/mission-canvas/restoration-controller.ts', 'apps/desktop/tests/restoration-runtime.mjs']; symbols/calls: ['canonicalContext.load', 'projectionGet', 'layoutMemoryGet', 'PtyRegistry.reattach']. Do not invent a substitute path or API.

Transform the typed input into the required output: INPUT=canonical Workstream and stored presentation references; OUTPUT=restored Canvas and Work Surfaces. Preserve every source behavior and use generated DTOs/operation metadata.
Prove foreign scope, missing authority, stale revision/cursor, unavailable capability, and ineligible/empty contribution behavior whenever applicable; fail closed rather than infer.
Run exactly these commands: ['node apps/desktop/tests/restoration-runtime.mjs']. Do not substitute screenshots for functional checks.
Write the bounded result and command outputs to docs/contracts/evidence/spec135-svelte-tasks/LIVE-004.json and link the changed files and exact acceptance statements.

authority_boundaries: Core owns eligibility, layout resolution, identity, authority, persistence, operations, and recomposition.
Svelte renders canonical ResolvedWorkspaceProjection output and approved generated renderers; it does not infer contributions or layout.
ScopeRef/ProjectRootKey -> WorkstreamId -> ContinuityId -> AttachmentKey -> SessionId/InstanceId -> runtime object -> WorkSurfaceId is the authority chain.
UIAI Engine exclusively owns browser execution and visual proof.
Generated OpenAPI, operation registry, TypeScript client, and validators own transport DTOs and route metadata.
prohibited_shortcuts: fixed dashboard or route-local screen inventory
invented ID, label, operation, renderer, activity, profile, panel, or workflow
project_root plus continuity_id treated as complete authority
ordinary child-process pipes substituted for PTY
fixture, screenshot, or terminal output treated as production completion
editing an unresolved symbolic target or bypassing an incomplete dependency
acceptance: No local snapshot becomes canonical; missing surfaces are reconciled truthfully.
Canvas/TUI switching, hide/show, Desktop restart, daemon reconnect, and contribution recomposition retain the required invariants.

stop_if: exact Workstream/Attachment authority is unavailable for an authority-bearing action
a named generated operation, renderer, semantic binding, or target path cannot be found
the requested behavior would require inventing product semantics
the check command is absent or cannot exercise the required output
stop_conditions.recovery: Do not guess. Mark the packet blocked with the missing exact item and continue only when its owning dependency or graph amendment resolves it.

reopen_if: any cited Spec 135 behavior is absent from the Svelte destination
the implementation renders only a static/fixture path
authority, stale-state, empty-state, or negative-case checks fail
the generated contract or operation registry changes
visual composition contradicts the adaptive handoff grammar after functional checks pass
